rv.q: Even when Barnes overstates his case, as he does by having Jack assume the role of a serial killer, the play is held together by McAvoy's mesmerising performance.

James McAvoy‘s luminous turn… Jamie Lloyd‘s production finds the excess-all-areas tone to persuade us that this blackly comic tale of awful aristos is more than just a period piece… Yes, there are moments where you wonder if all this politically charged, pre-Python archness… is dazzling but dated.
